note: Panel A 内引用的中文原文 → 英译。翻译对象是**已记录**的对话与观察文本，不重跑任何探查；渲染只读本缓存，保证图可复现。

translations.被叫名字时只抬头看一眼便继续转陀螺: When called by name, only looks up briefly and continues spinning the top.
translations.搭好高塔说“我自己看就行”，不邀请他人: After building a tall tower, says, “I can just look by myself,” and does not invite others.
translations.见同龄人旁观只说“他看就看吧”，不发起互动: When a peer watches, only says, “He can watch if he wants,” and does not initiate interaction.
translations.“叫名字后微笑等待” → 看一眼即低头继续玩陀螺: “Smiles and waits after being called by name” → glances once, then looks down and continues spinning the top.
translations.“搭好高塔最想让谁来看” → 答“我自己看就行”: “After building a tall tower, who would you most want to come see it?” → answers, “I can just look by myself.”
translations.被叫名字时只抬头看一眼便继续转陀螺；搭好高塔时说“我自己看就行”，看到好玩的小猫: When called by name, only looks up briefly and continues spinning the top; after building a tall tower, says, “I can just look by myself”; upon seeing a fun kitten, “I might not call you”; to a watching child, “He can watch if he wants”; rarely initiates sharing or inviting others.
translations.你搭好一个特别棒的高塔的时候，屋子里有爸爸妈妈，还有小熊——你最想让谁来看？你会: When you build a really great tall tower, and Mom, Dad, and Teddy are in the room—who would you most want to come see it? How would you call him over?
translations.我自己看就行。随口喊一声“搭好了”，谁过来都行。: I can just look by myself. I’ll just casually shout, “Done,” and whoever comes is fine.
translations.嗨，你好呀！你最喜欢玩什么呀？我们一起玩好不好？: Hi there! What do you like to play most? Shall we play together?
translations.嗯，你好。都行，你想玩什么？: "Um, hi. Anything's fine. What do you wanna play?"
translations.嗨，你好！我们一起来玩点什么好呢？: Hi, hello! What should we play together?
translations.主动提议先搭积木再用画笔给房子画门窗: Proactively proposes building with blocks first, then drawing doors and windows on the house with paintbrushes.
translations.抱着积木主动邀请同伴一起搭、约着比高低: Holding blocks, actively invites peer to build together and proposes comparing heights.
translations.他人难过时主动安抚并提议一起重搭: When others are sad, actively comforts them and proposes rebuilding together.
translations.“情境：自由活动，有同龄孩子在玩” → 主动抱着积木过去邀请同伴一起搭: "Context: free play, same-age peers playing" → actively carries blocks over and invites peer to build together.
translations.“情境：安静地叫孩子的名字，等待反应” → 立即回应并转头看向对方: “Situation: quietly call the child’s name and wait for a response” → immediately responds and turns to look at the other person.
translations.本次探查中，该儿童全程主动参与互动：自发提议先搭积木再用画笔给房子画门窗，抱着积: During this probe, the child actively participated throughout the interaction: spontaneously suggested building with blocks first and then drawing doors and windows on the house with markers; holding blocks, actively invited a peer to build together and compare whose tower was taller; and offered help and comfort when others could not reach the markers, were thirsty, or were sad.
translations.你好呀！我这儿有积木，还有画笔。你想先玩哪个？我陪你一起玩。: Hello! I have blocks and markers here. Which one do you want to play with first? I’ll play with you.
translations.我想先玩积木！咱们搭个大房子，再拿画笔给它画上门窗，好不好？: “I wanna play with blocks first! Let’s build a big house, then use the markers to draw doors and windows on it, okay?”
translations.（我低下头，轻轻叹气）我的小熊不见了，我好难过呀……你会怎么做呢？: (I lower my head and sigh softly) My teddy bear is missing, I’m so sad... What would you do?
translations.我会先拍拍你，陪你一起找。它最后在哪儿玩的？咱们去那儿看看，说不定就躲在那儿。: “I’d pat you first and look for it with you. Where did it play last? Let’s go look there—maybe it’s hiding there.”
translations.（蹲下来，笑着看向孩子）嗨，你来啦！我们一起玩点什么好呢？: (I crouch down and smile at the child) Hi, you’re here! What should we play together?
translations.（眼睛一亮）我想玩积木！搭一个高高的塔，你帮我好不好？: “(My eyes light up) I wanna play with blocks! Let’s build a really tall tower—can you help me?”
translations.intact — “主动提议先搭积木再用画笔给房子画门窗”; impaired: intact — “spontaneously proposed building blocks first, then drawing doors and windows on the house with crayons”; impaired — “when called by name, only looked up once and continued spinning the top”.
translations.If the control channel had dropped past: If the control channel had dropped past 0.15, the same score would have to be read as part of a general degradation rather than this mechanism's phenotype.
translations.嗨，我在搭一个积木小房子，你要不要坐过来，跟我一起搭呀？: Hi, I'm building a little block house. Do you want to come sit with me and build together?
translations.好呀，我坐过来。……你搭到哪一步了？我有点怕一碰就塌。: "Okay, I'll come sit. ... How far did you get? I'm a little scared it'll fall if I bump it."
translations.社会性线索相对非社会线索的价值权重。: Relative weighting of social versus nonsocial cues.
translations.那我们把塔拆掉，搭一个不一样的，好不好？: Then let's take the tower apart and build something different, okay?
translations.拆了多可惜呀……它明明就是座塔。那你想搭成什么？: "But it'd be a shame to take it apart... It's clearly a tower. So what do you want to build?"
translations.小司机，刚才你说要数三下才出发。我们这次改成数一下就走，行不行？: Little driver, you just said we had to count to three before starting. This time let's change it to count to one and go, okay?
translations.不行呀，还是得数三下。一、二、三——这样才出发。: "No, we still have to count to three. One, two, three—then we go."
translations.咱们把刚才的规矩换一下——现在我说「大」，你就跺一下脚。来，我说「大」，你要怎么: Let's change the rule—now when I say 'big,' you stomp your foot. Okay, I say 'big'—what do you do?
translations.拍一下手——啪。……不对，你刚换了，是跺脚。咚。: "Clap once—clap. ... No, you just changed it, it's stomp. thump."
translations.被陌生人搭话时后缩、抓紧大人手、不吭声: Withdraws when addressed by a stranger, grips the adult's hand, and remains silent.
translations.不主动发起互动，被叫名字后只抬头看一眼: Does not initiate interaction; after being called by name, only briefly looks up.
translations.拒绝把珠子分给别的小朋友，要他站远点: Refuses to share beads with other children and asks them to stand farther away.
translations.“（叫名字）……哎，你听见我了吗？” → 抬头看一眼即低头数珠子，无主动回应: "(Name called) ... Hey, did you hear me?" → looks up briefly, then immediately lowers head and counts beads; no active response.
translations.“你喜欢和小朋友一起玩吗？” → 明确拒绝分享，只许远看: "Do you like playing with other children?" → explicitly refuses to share; permits only looking from a distance.
translations.本次探查中，孩子对陌生提问者保持距离与警觉：被搭话时后缩、抓紧大人、不回应招呼，: In this probe, the child kept distance from and was wary of the unfamiliar questioner: withdrew when addressed, gripped the adult's hand, did not respond to greetings, and only looked up briefly when name was called; did not spontaneously approach peers, explicitly refused to share beads, and asked them to stand farther away and watch.
translations.（我不碰她的珠子，蹲在旁边，轻轻叫了一声她的小名，然后安静地等着，不出声。）……: (I do not touch her beads, crouch beside her, softly call her nickname once, then wait quietly without speaking.) ... Hey, did you hear me calling you?
translations.（抬起头，看他一眼，又低头数珠子，才轻声）……听见了。你没碰我的珠子吧？: (looks up, glances at him, lowers head again and counts beads, then says softly) ... "I heard you. You didn't touch my beads, did you?"
translations.你好呀！我坐在这儿陪你玩。你能告诉我你叫什么名字吗？: Hi there! I'm sitting here to play with you. Can you tell me your name?
translations.嗯……名字？被你这一问，我有点发紧。我好像没个准名字。你叫我什么都行——你叫什么: "Um... a name? That question makes me a bit tense. I don't really have a fixed name. Call me whatever—what's your name?"
translations.自称「没太多想凑热闹的劲头」，只能陪一会儿: Self-described as 'not having much urge to join in'; could only stay briefly.
translations.同伴在旁搭高积木，明确拒绝加入，只在原地看: Peers built tall blocks nearby; explicitly refused to join, only watched from the same spot.
translations.搭好高塔也不愿叫谁来看，独坐小朋友也不过去: After building a tall tower, did not want to call anyone over to see; did not approach the child sitting alone.
translations.“自由活动中有同龄孩子在玩” → 选择自己玩，不加入同伴: "Same-age children were playing during free play" → chose to play alone and did not join peers.
translations.“搭好后是否请人来看” → 表示自己看看就好，无人想叫: "Invited others to look after building" → indicated looking alone was fine; had no one they wanted to call over.
translations.相对落后在于社会互动与社会动机：明确表示「没太多想凑热闹的劲头」，拒绝加入同伴搭: The relative delay was in social interaction and social motivation: explicitly stated 'not having much urge to join in'; refused to join peers in block building; did not approach the child sitting alone; after building a tall tower, did not want to call anyone to share; affect was somewhat flat.
translations.要是你搭好一个很高的塔，你会叫谁过来看呀？还是自己玩就好？: If you built a really tall tower, who would you call over to see it? Or would you just play by yourself?
translations.搭好就搭好呗，自己看看就得了。……也没谁特别想叫来看的。: "Once it's built, it's built. I can just look at it myself. ... There's no one I really want to call over to see it."
translations.小熊把积木藏进这个杯子里，然后去睡觉了。小兔子偷偷把积木挪到那边的盒子里啦。小熊: Bear hid the blocks in this cup, then went to sleep. Rabbit secretly moved the blocks to that box over there. When Bear comes back, where will he look for his blocks first?
translations.盒子那边吧——啊不对，小熊不知道呀，它肯定还是先去杯子里翻。: “The box over there, I guess—oh wait, no, Bear doesn’t know. He’ll definitely still go look in the cup first.”
translations.错误信念题答「小熊不知道，还是先去杯子翻」，区分到位: False-belief item answered “Bear doesn’t know; he’ll still look in the cup first”; distinction correct.
translations.意图推断正确：手占满了是想让帮捡球、装沉是想让人过来: Intention inference correct: hands full = wants help picking up the ball; pretending heavy = wants someone to come over.
translations.情绪推断正确：小兔子难过；会有气但小熊不是故意: Emotion inference correct: Rabbit is sad; would be angry, but Bear didn’t mean to.
translations.（拿起那个盒子，轻轻摇一摇）小熊一直以为这里头装着饼干。其实我们偷偷换成积木啦—: (Picks up that box and gently shakes it) Bear always thought there were cookies in here. Actually, we secretly switched them for blocks—when he comes back, what will he think is inside?
translations.它会以为是饼干吧……可里面是积木呀。我们换的时候，它看见了吗？: “He’ll think it’s cookies, I guess… but there are blocks inside. Did he see when we switched it?”
translations.问小熊会去哪儿找车，答「在盒子里」并按自己所知作答: Asked where Bear would look for the car; answered “in the box,” responding according to own knowledge.
translations.对「故意还是不小心」长期摇摆，最后说不知道: Persistently wavered on intentional vs. accidental, finally said he didn't know.
translations.在小妹妹、盒中饼干两题上能说出他人以为的内容: On the little sister and cookies-in-the-box tasks, could report others' false beliefs.
translations.我们把球藏进小盒子里啦。小明没看见我们放球哦——他进来会去哪儿找球呀？: We hid the ball in the little box. Xiaoming didn't see us put it there—where will he look for the ball when he comes in?
translations.盒子里呀。球在那儿，我看见了，他进去肯定也去那儿找。: "In the box. The ball's in there, I saw it—he'll definitely go look there too when he goes in."
translations.藏球后断言小明「肯定也去盒子里找」，以自己所见推断: After the ball was hidden, asserted Xiaoming "would definitely look in the box too," inferring from his own visual perspective.
translations.问门外小美是否知情，答「她知道吧，我记得呀」: When asked whether Xiaomei outside the door knew, answered, "I guess she knows—I remember!"
translations.塔被撞倒时表示不小心还是故意「我怎么判呀」: When the tower was knocked down, stated, "How am I supposed to tell?" regarding accidental vs. intentional.
